scope: Isolated unmodified CRESSim engine feasibility, not tomato qualification
stock: Preserve supplied example physics and trajectory; remove visualizer; stop after 300 frames
material_comparison: PB parameters are not calibrated to MLS. This is a throughput and mechanism comparison, not equal accuracy.
cut_test: Sweep through x=0, withdraw fully, sweep through z=0, withdraw fully. Labels only analyze particles and are not supplied to engine. Compare unforced and single-quarter 0.01 m/s tangential pulse continuations.
independence_probe: Two material halves with 1 mm nominal gap. Apply 0.01 m/s tangential velocity to one half. Compare held slicer, absent slicer, 24 mm nominal gap. No friction, gravity or tool motion during probe.
independence_screen: Undriven half mean velocity below 1% of applied pulse when geometrically separated. A failure blocks adoption; passing is not full validation.
force_note: Dynamic shape flag records grid momentum exchange. getShapeForce returns accumulated impulse in this code; divide by actual integration duration, label unvalidated contact reaction. No fracture energy law is added.
stability_screen: Finite positions and velocities, preserved mass/count, inspect geometry and speed. No claim of convergence or experimental validation.
bounds: 600 wall seconds per test maximum; stop adoption on persistent-cut failure; do not patch engine to repair fracture within this study
